descriptions.d24f_word_vector_fill_insert_8035dc78: Inserts n copies of a word at pos in a vector (start +0, finish +4, storage end +12). With spare capacity it moves the tail up with memmove and fills, either shifting within the initialized tail or extending it first. Otherwise it allocates max(size, n) more elements through 0x80212fd4 with fallback 0x803413d8, copies prefix, fills, copies suffix, releases old storage via 0x802134fc and sets the new bounds.
